steps.text: Form teams of at least 2, as even as possible; teammates sit together
3 players: no teams - each player has their own piece
Board in the middle, sandglass next to it
Each team's playing piece on the start space
Sort the cards by the numbers on their backs; shuffle each stack facedown onto its rectangle
On the start space you may pick any term but must use the required mode
3 players: only Open Rounds; performer and guesser both advance; no bumping
The opening team picks a performer, who chooses a stack (3, 4 or 5) and lifts the top card
